verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no public per-service pricing pages and no official cost estimator or calculator. The only cost material is Free Trial credits, Always Free offers and budget alerts, which are adjacent features. Community remarks about cheap bandwidth are anecdotal and not published pricing, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything
